problems: Storyboard frame 5 and the 25% frame: the sun lands inside the group of animals. It overlaps the sheep and the brown creature with the party hat, cutting through their bodies instead of touching them, and none of them flinches or turns. A glowing ball landing in their middle gets no reaction.

Caption 'beside Pinchy, who didn't look': a viewer has no way of telling which animal is Pinchy. The crab is small and in the background (frames 6-9, 50% frame), and nothing shows anyone not looking in a way you would notice.
Caption 'rolled': the sun is a plain white disc with no marks on it, so it slides across the ground (frames 6-12). Nothing shows it rolling.

Caption 'straight through a bush' (frames 9-11, 50% frame): the sun passes into the bush's leaves and the bush does not move or bend. It looks like the two objects clip through each other, not like something pushing through a bush.

Frames 13-16 and the 75% frame: once the sun is in the sea it is only a blurry cyan blob at the bottom edge of a dark frame, and it stays like that for the last ~1.2 s. There is no splash and no ripple, and the water does not react. The film ends on an empty, dark shot.
Frames 1-3: the first second shows an empty dark meadow. The sun only appears as a sliver at the top edge of frame 3, so you miss the drop itself.
Lighting: the sun is so bright it is a flat white shape with no form. Around it the ground turns acid-yellow, while the rest of the scene is dim night (frames 6-12).
posts.critique: The idea of a dropped sun rolling unnoticed into the sea is charming, but what happens on screen falls apart. The sun clips through animals and a bush that don't react, it slides more than it rolls, and the sea takes it with no reaction at all. The last part of the film is a dim blob at the edge of the frame.
